integrity: The formulas are supported by a self-contained combinatorial proof; finite Python calculations are supplementary and no independent mathematical audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact values are proved for unweighted simple wheels K_1 join C_n with n at least four. The result does not classify arbitrary apex, directed, or weighted graphs. Priority relative to unindexed DFS cut-congestion literature is not independently established.
title: Exact depth-first back-edge congestion of wheel graphs
